dsh-at-any is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Codex-style `@file` mentions for the web GUI: search and reference workspace files of every format (.java, .vue, PDF, images, extension-less, hidden) with no index truncation. Replaces dsh-at-file.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-3ccc0e8825324cf7f6d6.html
